'''Thrakia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of an [[Unidentified Thrakia species|unidentified species]], described as an intelligent [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]] with genetically transmitted memories.

==Description==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> Thrakia was located in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]], in one of four distinct regions of the Cluster, the [[Interior Region]],<ref name="EA" /> which was considered the heart of the entire Cluster.<ref name="CEHC">{{CSWECite|II|16|Hapes Cluster}}</ref> Besides [[Ut]],<ref name="CEU">{{CSWECite|III|283|Ut}}</ref><ref name="EA" /> [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]], [[Selab]], Thrakia and [[Gallinore]], there were roughly twenty other worlds throughout the region.<ref name="CTD" /> The [[Thrakia system/Legends|Thrakia star system]] was connected by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Jovaria system/Legends|Jovaria system]].<ref name="EA" /> Thrakia was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="CET">{{CSWECite|III|239|Thrakia}}</ref> of an [[Sentience/Legends|intelligent]] [[Unidentified Thrakia species|insectoid species]] with genetically transmitted memories.<ref name="CPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>

==History==
The [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] was a grouping of sixty-three [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]<ref name="CPL" /><ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CEHCS">{{CSWECite|II|16|Hapes Consortium}}</ref> and at least 119 known worlds within the cluster's boundaries.<ref name="CEHC" /> It was surrounded by vast drifts of [[Gas/Legends|gas]] and ionized particles known as the [[Transitory Mists]], which made hyperspace travel all but impossible except for a few carefully guarded routes into the cluster.<ref name="EA" />

[[File:Interior_Region.png|left|thumb|260px|The Interior Region of the Hapes Cluster, where the planet Thrakia was located]]
Beginning around [[4200 BBY]],<ref name="EA" /> the Hapes Cluster was originally settled by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] called the [[Lorell Raiders]],<ref name="CPL" /><ref name="SWE" /> who turned it into a haven for themselves,<ref name="CTD" /><ref name="EA" /> forming bases and storing their ill-gotten gains.<ref name="CTD" /> When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Battle of Lorell|wiped out]] the Lorell Raiders, the worlds of Hapes were forgotten for a time,<ref name="CPL" /> but the women of the Hapes Cluster established a matriarchal society marked by near-constant palace intrigues and assassinations.<ref name="EA" /> The center of the Cluster, the [[Interior Region]], was the first region conquered and controlled by the line of [[Hapan Royal House|hereditary matriarchs]] known as the [[Queen Mother]]s.<ref name="CTD" /> Later, the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]], ruled by the Queen Mothers, colonized sixty-three worlds within the Cluster, though perhaps twice that number were thought to be habitable.<ref name="EA" />

During the early days of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="CPL" /> Thrakia was known to be the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of an [[Sentience/Legends|intelligent]]<ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CET" /> [[Unidentified Thrakia species|insectoid species]] with genetically transmitted memories<ref name="CPL" /><ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CET" /> that worshiped their ability to communicate.<ref name="CPL" /> Some [[300 BBY/Legends|three hundred years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="CET" /> the insectoids remembered that, in the recent past, they had communicated only through scent before apparently discovering that they could also communicate by clicking their mandibles.<ref name="CPL" /><ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CET" /> Even after many years,<ref name="CPL" /><ref name="SWE" /> they continued to regard this ability with awe and viewed it as a sign that they had been gifted by a power<ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CET" /> from some higher being.<ref name="CPL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thrakia was introduced in the novel ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'',<ref name="CPL" /> which was written by [[Dave Wolverton]] and released in [[1994]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> In [[1998]],<ref name="San Diego Comic-Con Exclusives">{{ThisWeek|-BZX-WxjhFE|San Diego Comic-Con Exclusives, Brand New LEGO Art, and More!|sw_url=video/san-diego-comic-con-exclusives-brand-new-lego-art-and-more|date=2020-07-02}}</ref> an entry for Thrakia was added to the reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which revealed that it was a planet.<ref name="SWE" />

The PC [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Thrakia in the «Quelli Sector»,<ref name="RVG" /><ref name="RVGG">[[Star Wars: Rebellion: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Rebellion'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> a misspelling of the true [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]], of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> However, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Thrakia system/Legends|Thrakia star system]] and the planet itself in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim Territories]].<ref name="EA" />
